subject: Strategic Management
notes: Strategy core. No numerical questions apply; extra objective and case items included.

questions.text: The long term direction and scope of an organisation to gain advantage is its
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Strategy is the long term direction and scope of an organisation.

questions.text: Strategy formulated for the whole organisation is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Corporate strategy covers the entire organisation and its portfolio.

questions.text: The first stage of strategic management is environmental
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Environmental scanning identifies opportunities and threats.

questions.text: Strategic management is a one time activity rather than a continuous process
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Strategic management is a continuous process of formulation implementation and evaluation.

questions.text: List the three levels of strategy
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Corporate strategy business strategy and functional strategy.
questions.explanation: Strategy operates at these three organisational levels.

questions.text: Explain the strategic management process
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: The process moves from defining mission and objectives through environmental analysis strategy formulation and implementation to evaluation and control.
questions.explanation: Trace the stages from mission to evaluation.

questions.text: The analysis of strengths weaknesses opportunities and threats is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: SWOT analyses internal strengths and weaknesses and external opportunities and threats.

questions.text: The external factors affecting a firm such as competition and technology form its
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: The environment provides opportunities and threats to the firm.

questions.text: Strengths and weaknesses are internal while opportunities and threats are external
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: SW and OT reflect internal and external factors respectively.

questions.text: State the components of a SWOT analysis
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: These four components summarise the firms strategic position.

questions.text: Explain the importance of environmental scanning
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Environmental scanning helps anticipate change identify opportunities and threats and align strategy with the external environment for competitive advantage.
questions.explanation: Cover anticipation and strategic alignment benefits.

questions.text: A strategy of expanding into new markets with existing products is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Market development takes existing products into new markets.

questions.text: The strategy of increasing sales of existing products in existing markets is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Market penetration grows share within current markets.

questions.text: Diversification is a growth strategy of entering new products and new markets
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Diversification moves into new products and markets simultaneously.

questions.text: List the generic strategies of Porter
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: These generic strategies give competitive advantage.

questions.text: Explain the Ansoff growth matrix
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: The Ansoff matrix offers four growth options combining products and markets namely market penetration market development product development and diversification.
questions.explanation: Describe each quadrant of the matrix.

questions.text: The process of putting chosen strategies into action is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Implementation translates strategy into action through structure and resources.

questions.text: The structure that follows strategy according to Chandler means structure is determined by
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Chandlers thesis is that organisational structure follows strategy.

questions.text: Strategy implementation is usually easier than strategy formulation
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Implementation is often harder because it involves people culture and coordination.

questions.text: List the factors affecting strategy implementation
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Organisational structure culture leadership resources and systems.
questions.explanation: These factors determine how well strategy is executed.

questions.text: Explain the relationship between strategy and organisational structure
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Strategy determines the structure needed to execute it so changes in strategy require matching structural adjustments as Chandlers structure follows strategy thesis holds.
questions.explanation: Link strategy changes to structural adaptation.

questions.text: The process of monitoring results and comparing them with goals is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Evaluation measures performance against strategic objectives.

questions.text: The tool that measures performance across financial customer internal and learning perspectives is the
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: The balanced scorecard evaluates four perspectives of performance.

questions.text: Strategic evaluation should be a continuous process not just at the end
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Continuous evaluation allows timely corrective action.

questions.text: List the criteria for evaluating strategy
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: These Rumelt criteria assess the quality of a strategy.

questions.text: Explain the steps in strategic evaluation and control
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Evaluation sets standards measures performance compares results with standards and takes corrective action to keep strategy on track.
questions.explanation: Trace the control cycle for strategy.

questions.text: The system of rules and practices by which companies are directed is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Corporate governance is the system by which companies are directed and controlled.

questions.text: The moral principles that guide business conduct are business
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Business ethics are the standards of right and wrong in business.

questions.text: Good corporate governance protects the interests of all stakeholders
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Governance balances the interests of shareholders and other stakeholders.

questions.text: State the principles of corporate governance
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: These principles underpin sound corporate governance.

questions.text: Explain the importance of corporate governance
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Corporate governance builds investor confidence ensures accountability reduces risk and fraud and supports long term value creation.
questions.explanation: Cover investor trust accountability and value creation.

questions.text: Assertion: A clear mission statement guides strategic decisions. Reason: The mission defines the purpose and scope of the organisation
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.topic: Strategy concepts levels and process (assertion reason)
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Both are true but reason does not explain assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: A mission clarifies purpose and scope thereby directing strategy.

questions.text: Match the strategy to its direction
questions.subject: Strategic Management
options: Market penetration - existing markets existing products
Market development - new products existing markets
Product development - new markets existing products
questions.explanation: Market penetration grows share with existing products in existing markets.

questions.text: The vision statement describes what the organisation aspires to become in the future
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: A vision is the desired future state of the organisation.

questions.text: The framework that analyses industry competition through five forces was given by
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Porter proposed the five forces model of industry competition.

questions.text: Explain the five forces model of competition
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Porter five forces are rivalry among competitors threat of new entrants bargaining power of buyers bargaining power of suppliers and threat of substitutes which determine industry profitability.
questions.explanation: Describe each force and its effect on competition.

questions.text: Read the case: A company wants to grow but its current market is saturated. Using the Ansoff matrix suggest two growth options
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: The company could pursue market development by entering new markets or product development by offering new products in existing markets.
questions.explanation: Apply two Ansoff options to the saturated market situation.

questions.text: Read the case: A firm has strong technology but weak distribution and faces rising demand. Recommend a strategy based on a SWOT analysis
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: The firm should exploit its technology strength and rising demand opportunity while fixing weak distribution through partnerships or investment to capture growth.
questions.explanation: Link internal strengths and weaknesses to external opportunities.

questions.text: Strategy that focuses on a narrow market segment is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Focus strategy targets a specific segment or niche.

questions.text: Explain the difference between vision and mission
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: A vision is the future aspiration while a mission is the present purpose and scope of the organisation.
questions.explanation: Vision is future oriented and mission is present oriented.

questions.text: Explain the role of leadership in strategy implementation
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Leadership communicates the vision aligns people allocates resources and motivates change to translate strategy into action and overcome resistance.
questions.explanation: Cover communication alignment and change management.

questions.text: The cost of following one strategic option instead of another is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Choosing one strategy means forgoing the benefits of alternatives.

questions.text: Explain the importance of strategy evaluation
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Evaluation detects deviations from plans assesses whether strategy is achieving goals and triggers corrective action in a changing environment.
questions.explanation: Cover deviation detection and corrective action.

questions.text: List the tools for strategic analysis
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: SWOT analysis PEST analysis Porter five forces and value chain analysis.
questions.explanation: These tools analyse internal and external strategic factors.

questions.text: Explain the importance of ethics in strategic management
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Ethics builds trust and reputation guides responsible decisions and sustains long term success by aligning strategy with societal values.
questions.explanation: Cover reputation trust and long term sustainability.

questions.text: A conglomerate strategy of entering unrelated businesses is
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Unrelated diversification enters businesses with no common link.

questions.text: Merging with or acquiring a competitor is horizontal integration
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Horizontal integration combines firms at the same stage of the industry.

questions.text: Explain the factors influencing strategic choice
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Strategic choice is influenced by internal resources and capabilities external environment risk managers attitudes and stakeholder expectations.
questions.explanation: Cover internal and external determinants of strategy choice.

questions.text: The core competences that give a firm a lasting edge are its
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.explanation: Distinctive competences are capabilities competitors cannot easily copy.

questions.text: Explain the relationship between corporate and business strategy
questions.subject: Strategic Management
questions.correctAnswer: Corporate strategy decides which businesses to be in while business strategy decides how to compete within each chosen business so corporate strategy sets the frame for business strategy.
questions.explanation: Contrast the scope of the two levels and their linkage.
